source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]))
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == divider for v in row)]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_bands = []
    start = 0
    for cut in row_cuts + [h]:
        if start < cut:
            row_bands.append((start, cut))
        start = cut + 1
    col_bands = []
    start = 0
    for cut in col_cuts + [w]:
        if start < cut:
            col_bands.append((start, cut))
        start = cut + 1
    colors = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != divider:
                colors[value] = colors.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        outrow = []
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != divider
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            outrow.append(1 if marks > 1 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
'''
